description_en: Calls the ImportAppAlertRules operation to create application alert rules
description_zh: 调用ImportAppAlertRules接口创建应用报警规则
name: ImportAppAlertRules

parameters.help_en: The alert template ID. You must specify at least one of TemplateAlertId and TemplageAlertConfig. If both parameters are specified, TemplateAlertId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 报警模板ID。TemplateAlertId和TemplageAlertConfig必须至少填写一个。如果两个参数都填写，则TemplateAlertId优先
parameters.name: template_alert_id

parameters.help_en:
The Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) application IDs (PIDs) associated with the common alert rules. The value is in the JsonArrayListStr format.

In the ARMS console, go to Application Monitoring > Applications and click the name of the target application. The URL in the browser address bar contains the PID of the application in the format of pid=xxx. Because the browser encodes the URL, you must modify the PID. For example, if the PID in the URL is xxx%4074xxx, replace %40 with @. The PID is xxx@74xxx
parameters.help_zh:
常见报警规则关联的ARMS应用ID（即PID），格式为JsonArrayListStr。

在ARMS控制台的应用监控>应用列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx
parameters.name: pids

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the application associated with the application alert rule
parameters.help_zh: 应用报警规则关联的应用所属地域的ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the alert contact groups. The value is in the JSONArray format
parameters.help_zh: 报警联系人分组ID，格式为JSONArray
parameters.name: contact_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically enable the alert rule after it is created. Default value: `false`.

`true`: automatically enables the alert rule.
`false`: does not automatically enable the alert rule
parameters.help_zh:
生成报警规则后是否自动启动报警规则。默认为`false`。

`true`：自动启动报警规则
`false`：不自动启动报警规则
parameters.name: is_auto_start

If both parameters are specified, TemplateAlertId takes precedence. For more information about this parameter, see Supplementary description of the TemplageAlertConfig parameter below
parameters.help_zh: ARMS报警规则的配置JSON串。TemplateAlertId和TemplageAlertConfig必须至少填写一个。如果两个参数都填写，则TemplateAlertId优先。关于此字段的详细说明参见下文关于参数TemplageAlertConfig的补充说明
parameters.name: templage_alert_config
